name: mob-design
description: Dark-native design system for dense product UI. Three tiers of CSS custom properties, a dual mono/sans type contract, depth from surface plus a 1px border rather than shadow, and three density zones that move rhythm without moving control geometry. Ships as source: CSS, a Tailwind preset, and W3C design-token JSON. No dependencies, no build step.
//: css/tokens.css is the source of truth for every value. tokens/*.json and tailwind/preset.js are mirrors of it — see tokens/README.md for how to verify they still match.

scripts.//: Intentionally empty. This package ships as source — the CSS is the artefact, the JSON mirrors are hand-maintained, and the Tailwind preset is plain CommonJS. Adding a build step would put a compiled copy of the tokens between the design system and the product, which is the drift this system is built to avoid.
